common.incomeCurrencyTips: If the holding currency and income currency are not the same currency, interest will be calculated based on the staking currency and converted to the income currency at the exchange rate at the time of interest settlement.
common.redeemTips: Once the redemption operation is completed, the current product assets will be immediately returned to your spot wallet. Please note that each current product has a daily redemption limit, and the redemption limit may be adjusted. If there are a large number of redemption requests, redemption may be temporarily delayed and completed after liquidity is restored.
common.currentRewardRules: For current products, we will provide tiered annual returns, which adopt a tiered structure. The return will start to be calculated at 08:00 (UTC+8) the day after subscription. It will be distributed to your spot wallet at 08:00 (UTC+8) the day after calculation (i.e., subscription day + two days). The tiered annual return rate may change daily.
common.rewardRulesTips: The annual return rate of the fixed-term product you subscribe to is calculated according to the annual interest rate when the subscription is successful. The return will start to be calculated at 08:00 (UTC+8) the day after subscription. The return will be distributed to your spot account at 08:00 (UTC+8) the day after calculation starts (i.e., two days after subscription). Daily return = Subscribed assets * Annual return rate / 365 (accurate to decimal places, the specific number of digits depends on the currency)
common.earlyRedemptionTips: For designated fixed-term products, you can redeem assets at any time before maturity. Once confirmed, the redemption process will be irreversible. If you redeem early, you will give up the accrued interest income of the product. The principal you used to subscribe to the fixed-term product will be returned to your spot wallet within 72 hours. In case of extreme market volatility, network delays, or excessive requests, redemption may be delayed.
common.cancelSubscribeTips: If you cancel your subscription on the day of subscription and confirm the cancellation before 07:59 (UTC+8) the next day, you can successfully cancel the subscription, and your principal will be refunded to your personal spot account. After 07:59 (UTC+8), you cannot cancel the subscription, and you will need to comply with the early redemption policy.

financial.needToCompleteTheFollowingOperations: You need to complete the following operations before subscribing
financial.question: Question

question1.title: What is financial?
question1.answer: Financial is a one-stop asset management platform under our company, focusing on providing professional and high-quality asset management services. Based on high returns and high security, it fully meets the diverse investment needs of users. Users can choose products with different return and risk levels according to their needs and make their assets grow.

question2.title: What are the types of financial products?
question2.answer: We provide a variety of financial products for users to choose from, such as current financial products and fixed-term financial products. In the future, we will launch more financial products to meet the investment preferences, investment vision, and risk preferences of more users.

question3.title: Where can I view the financial products I have subscribed to?
question3.answer: You can view the products you have subscribed to in the asset-financial account.

question4.title: What will happen if I redeem my fixed-term product early?
question4.answer: For designated fixed-term products, you can redeem your assets at any time before maturity. Once confirmed, the redemption process will be irreversible. If you redeem early, you will give up the accrued interest income of the product. The principal you used to subscribe to the fixed-term product will be returned to your spot wallet within 72 hours. In case of extreme market volatility, network delays, or excessive requests, redemption may be delayed.

question5.title: What will happen if I have selected automatic subscription to financial products?
question5.answer: After enabling automatic subscription to current products, your assets in the spot wallet will be automatically subscribed to this current product at 02:00 and 18:00 (UTC+8) every day. After enabling automatic subscription to fixed-term products, the fixed-term product will be automatically renewed with the same fixed-term product when it matures. If not enabled, your assets will be redeemed after maturity.

questionStaking.title: What is Staking?
questionStaking.answer: Staking is a digital asset financial product, and you can obtain interest income after the holding period or lock-in period of the product ends. It mainly includes “current financial products and fixed-term financial products”. We will select high-quality projects to provide rich staking income for global staking users. Currently, the first-issue projects will provide multiple return methods, such as “staking and holding”. Holding financial products: users only need to hold the asset to obtain income. Fixed-term financial products: according to different projects, you can choose different lock-in periods for different projects. After the lock-in period, you will receive all rewards and interest income. If you redeem the asset in the lock-in period, you will lose the interest income that has been generated.
